description: Returns the current weather and a 3-day forecast for a given city. Data is read from a local cache refreshed hourly; no user data leaves the machine.
name: get_weather

description: Evaluates a basic arithmetic expression safely (no variables, no function calls). Useful for quick math inside a task.
name: calculator

description: Reads a markdown note from the user's local notes folder by filename. Read-only; cannot write, delete, or access paths outside the notes folder.
name: read_notes
